decision_cruda.rationale: LH-04 is down (radio and CMMS agree), likely repair 11:30. LH-10 is idle at the workshop, 0.33 h from C512-02, so no home production is lost. C512-02 has 291 t at 7.3 g/t. Without a loan, LH-04 could load about 178 t after repair. With LH-10 the stope can be fully mucked, which adds about 110 t, or about 25 oz. Central is truck-limited (116 t/h inflow against 91 t/h trucks), but with LH-04 out the inflow is about 80 t/h. The stockpile has 116 t of room, so adding LH-10 will not fill it. I did not take loaders from other producing stopes or from the critical-path heading.
